model_output:
```sql
WITH blencoe_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Blencoe' AND border_type = 'city'
)
SELECT MAX(rast_val) AS highest_elevation
FROM (
  SELECT ST_Value(rast, 1, pt.geom) AS rast_val
  FROM public.dem_us r
  CROSS JOIN blencoe_geom pt
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, pt.geom)
) sub;
```
